facts.fact: ANAM states that its newly installed PUMA 2025 station lets it receive real-time data and images from the third-generation MTG meteorological satellite, with reception every 10 minutes instead of 15.
ANAM states that the PUMA 2025 and CLIMSA stations strengthen its forecasting capacity and that the higher-resolution satellite images raise the precision of its short- and medium-term forecasts.

ANAM states that the 10-minute satellite data reception is decisive for tracking fast weather events and for issuing more responsive early alerts, and that the images help early detection of violent storms.
